name: Chalk Stripe
description: Suiting flannel: soft, broad chalk lines in pale colors on a dark ground, each pair parted by a fine pinstripe.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @pd(@m(@X, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--t)); opacity: .9; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 36%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 64%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 36%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 64%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -2%; width: 4%; background-color: var(--color4); opacity: .35; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
